import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

### Recommended product
One species, `ref`, on the existing ledger-tools kit. Folded by default. A `plate` tile, `REF` kicker, parent crumbs in the home hue, title, a type pill (`CHAT` / `BLOG` / `PAPER` / …), and chips only when the facts exist. Absorb the managed H1 and reading-task embed at render; do not delete them. Painting never spawns bob. Native Properties hide under the family `props_v1` gate.

`==` yes, after the lock: Property Editor focused on `title`. No add/remove/reorder/type. Rename, Today, parent refile, and reading-state stay on the commands and the `#task #ref` checkbox they already have.

### Why this, not the request as written
Refs are the largest typed family without a card: **1,377 listed notes**, 52% chats, 92% of *modern* notes chats. A paper-thumbnail inspector would overfit the minority and fight Bob Refs plus the note body.

The live reliability bug is already there: `bob props` treats `id`, `status`, `parent`, hashes, and `highlights_*` as **loose**. Generic `+` can trash pipeline keys today. Lock those as identity/derived in bob-cli first (`feat(props)!` if the JSON role change is a contract break). That track does not wait for `qm`.

### Parallelism
Coordination at three plugin seams, not everywhere:
- **Now:** lock pipeline keys in bob-cli
- **After `qm.1`:** species, `plate` tile, T1 silence, preview gate (new species default-gated), card fragments
- **After `qm.6`:** extend the takeover harness
- **After `qm.7`:** docs, `glossary:ref-card`, family glossary, deploy

Invariant: always-live kinds stay the pre-`qm` set. If `ref` is added to `PROPERTY_CARD_KINDS` while the gate only special-cases notebook/prose, `qm.7` deleting that gate would ship ref cards by accident.

### Glossary
Draft for `glossary:ref-card` is in the report, plus sequenced “not the Ref Card” clauses on `glossary:ref-panel` and `glossary:reference-note`. Family-edit `glossary:property-card` only after `qm.7`.
